The Gutman Lab

Studying large data sets to advance biological research

Dr. David Gutman is an assistant professor of Biomedical Informatics at Emory University focused on understanding genomic bases of biological imaging.

Cancer Informatics

The goal of cancer informatics is to obtain and organize large amounts of data (histology, radiology, etc.) to formulate hypotheses about cancer development and guide diagnostic and prognostic decisions.

Non-human MRI Analysis

MRI from non-human models offers a unique perspective into neural functioning and complements experimental techniques not available in human specimens.

NeuroGenomics

In-silico methods to identify and measure brain features using radiological imaging to study pathological development.

Google Scholar

This lab site does not import data from Google Scholar (there is no supported API). Peer-reviewed lists here come from PubMed sync. For live citation counts, h-index, and interactive charts, use your Scholar profile.

OpenAlex vs PubMed gaps — we cannot query Scholar automatically; this compares your PubMed cache to the OpenAlex author graph (run npm run compare:openalex to refresh).

Manual Scholar export: save BibTeX from Scholar as content/publications/scholar-export.bib, then run npm run sanity:scholar for a quick check against PubMed cache (writes scholar-sanity-check.json). View BibTeX in the site (after rebuild).

Google Scholar profile & metrics · My library

To show a citation chart here, save a screenshot from your Scholar profile as public/images/google-scholar-citations.png and rebuild.
